CastAs-ListType-20.xml:
<ns0:test-case xmlns:ns0="http://www.w3.org/2010/09/qt-fots-catalog" name="CastAs-ListType-20" covers-30="cast-to-list">
       <ns0:description>Cannot use a list type name in a sequence type</ns0:description>
       <ns0:created by="Michael Kay" on="2012-05-28" />
       <ns0:modified by="O'Neil Delpratt" on="2012-05-29" change="fix bug 17230" />
       <ns0:dependency type="spec" value="XQ30+" />
       <ns0:test>
         let $v as xs:NMTOKENS := xs:NMTOKENS("a b c")
         return count($v)
       </ns0:test>
       <ns0:result>
         <ns0:error code="XPST0051" />
       </ns0:result>
   </ns0:test-case>
CastAs-ListType-20.expression:
let $v as xs:NMTOKENS := xs:NMTOKENS("a b c")
         return count($v)
